overview.text: Today's developments showcase critical advances across agent reliability, world modeling, and foundational releases. In agent research, Trajectory2Gym re-evaluates tool-use supervision by addressing hidden multi-step dependencies, while Trial by Trace benchmarks agent harnesses to improve failure attribution. In simulation and modeling, Google DeepMind introduced Genie 4 for real-time world simulation, and KRAFTON released Raon-1-mini-preview, a Mixture-of-Experts language model built from scratch. Additionally, developers gained access to comprehensive educational content via a full video course on building reasoning models from the ground up, covering inference-time scaling and reinforcement learning using Python and PyTorch. These updates collectively emphasize a strong industry focus on rigorous evaluation, robust harness design, and advanced architectural scaling for both researchers and practitioners navigating modern AI systems.

entries.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
entries.summary: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time.
entries.why: It highlights why successful tool-use trajectories require better supervision to capture hidden multi-step dependencies accurately.

entries.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
entries.summary: Genie 4: our new world model unlocking unprecedented realism in real-time simulation.
entries.why: It delivers an unprecedented level of realism for real-time simulation using a new world model.

entries.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
entries.summary: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation.
entries.why: It provides a crucial benchmark for evaluating AI agent harnesses to improve reliability and failure attribution.

entries.title: Building Reasoning Models from the Ground Up: A Full Video Course
entries.summary: Over 11 hours of coding videos on evaluation, inference-time scaling, reinforcement learning, and distillation, with Python and PyTorch.
entries.why: It offers practical coding videos on reasoning models, inference-time scaling, and reinforcement learning.

entries.title: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
entries.summary: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths.
entries.why: It enables cinematic character video generation with large-angle camera control and world consistency.

entries.title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
entries.summary: Localized AI manipulations in long-form videos often affect brief events within otherwise authentic content, making video-level classification insufficient for forensic analysis.
entries.why: It addresses localized AI manipulation forensics in long-form videos where standard classification falls short.

entries.title: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL
entries.summary: Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective.
entries.why: It proposes a precision objective to mitigate reward hacking during rubric-based reinforcement learning.

entries.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2 · Hugging Face
entries.summary: Release [2026/10/27] 🚀 We release Unlimited OCR 2, achieving unlimited-horizon parsing with SR-SWA.
entries.why: It introduces unlimited-horizon parsing capabilities using SR-SWA for advanced document processing.

entries.title: KRAFTON/Raon-1-mini-preview · Hugging Face
entries.summary: Raon-1 mini is a 30B-A4B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model, designed and trained from scratch by KRAFTON AI. It demonstrates strong capabilities in Korean conversation and agentic tasks.
entries.why: It provides a new Mixture-of-Experts language model trained from scratch for Korean conversation and agentic tasks.

entries.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
entries.why: It delivers a popular image-text-to-text model variant with extensive community downloads and usage.

entries.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
entries.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to bring business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT and power new Oracle offerings.
entries.why: It expands enterprise integration by bringing business applications and AI agents directly into ChatGPT.

entries.title: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
entries.why: It enables developers to build specialized multimodal models effectively using new architectural tooling.

entries.title: Coding From the Himalayas With an Offline AI Agent
entries.summary: How to set up and run an offline coding agent using OpenCode, Ollama and Qwen.
entries.why: It demonstrates practical offline coding agent deployment in remote settings using local open-source tools.

entries.title: Anthropic Versus Anthropic
entries.why: It offers critical industry perspective on the complexities and strategic positioning of Anthropic as an organization.

entries.title: Amazon’s Trainium Takes a Strike at the Training King
entries.summary: Trainium Best for Inference? But now good for Training too, Native Trainium PyTorch, High Quality CI, TorchTitan, GPU Impossible Profiler
entries.why: It evaluates Amazon's Trainium capabilities for native PyTorch training and competitive AI chip performance.
